metadata.purpose: PACK-10 probe (augments): the clinicbase pack composed with a throwaway extension pack ('clinicext') that uses the `augments` keyword to additively contribute a bloodType field onto clinicbase::Patient. Proves: the extension mechanism works end-to-end through the real compile pipeline, the Patient concept ends up with both name (from base) and bloodType (from extension), and the `augments` keyword is accepted by the schema.
